title: Bottom bracket squeals loudly problem, need advice
main: My bottom bracket squeals loudly when I ride in the rain even after a full cleaning. The front brake loses pressure after I climb out of the saddle even after a full cleaning.
Sounds like cable tension to me. The front brake keeps slipping when I brake hard on descents and the shop could not reproduce it.
Try a different valve core before anything else. My new tubeless setup squeals loudly when I pedal above 90 rpm even after a full cleaning.
Sounds like cable tension to me. The front brake keeps slipping when I ride in the rain so I am not sure what to check next.
Sounds like cable tension to me. The rear wheel hub squeals loudly when I shift into the smallest cog but only on cold mornings.
